name: LightBed
tagline: Full-body red and near-infrared bed. 41,600 LEDs.
description: The OneBase LightBed is full-body light therapy with minimal operational demand. 41,600 LEDs across five wavelengths from 633 to 940 nm, adjustable intensity, a built-in timer, multiple cooling systems, Bluetooth audio and an ergonomic padded bed. Short sessions, high throughput.

highlights.title: Five wavelengths
highlights.body: 633 and 660 nm red for collagen, skin health and inflammation; 810, 850 and 940 nm near-infrared for deeper cellular repair, circulation and muscle recovery.

highlights.title: Full-body coverage
highlights.body: Red and near-infrared delivered simultaneously across the whole body in one enclosed session.

highlights.title: Adjustable intensity and timer
highlights.body: Sessions tuned to each user's sensitivity and goal, with consistent exposure every time.

highlights.title: Built for comfort and safety
highlights.body: Ergonomic padded bed, multiple cooling systems, eye protection, intuitive controls.

highlights.title: Bluetooth audio
highlights.body: Clients play their own music or audio during the session.

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.value: Length 89.5" (227.3 cm) · Depth 51" (129.5 cm) · Height 44" (111.8 cm)

faqs.q: How does red light therapy work in a bed?
faqs.a: Exposure to red and near-infrared wavelengths stimulates cellular metabolism, supports collagen production, improves circulation and reduces inflammation.
Generally, yes, when used as directed. The wavelengths are non-ionising and carry none of the risks of UV. Follow the guidelines and consult a healthcare professional for underlying conditions.

faqs.q: How often should clients use it?
faqs.a: Frequency varies with goals. Many start with a few sessions per week and adjust based on response.
Pregnant women, people with photosensitivity conditions or on photosensitising medication, and those with certain skin conditions should consult a healthcare professional first.

faqs.q: Is the LightBed suitable for home use?
faqs.a: Full-body beds suit professional settings such as spas, wellness centres and fitness facilities. Panels are the home option.
